name: front-desk-ai-orchestrator
description: Front Desk AI Orchestrator - Complete hotel front desk AI assistance system

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../dashboard && npm install && cd ../extension && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd dashboard && npm start"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:extension
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:dashboard
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && npm run lint 2>/dev/null || echo 'No lint script in backend'
scripts.lint:dashboard: cd dashboard && npm run lint 2>/dev/null || echo 'No lint script in dashboard'

author: Front Desk Team
